currentParagraphText: “In moments like these, I get really jealous I can’t give out Blessings,” Minaga sighed loudly. “The system is truly unfair, oppressing me like that.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “The only unfair thing the system has done was not erase you from the multiverse simply on account of how absurd your existence is,” the King scoffed, his left arm already well on its way to being fully regenerated.
